method: Root separately read all 623 source lines and every query row's name, exact target suffix/CWE digits and all three inclusion cells. Exact repeated icon syntax and common URL prefix were compacted for display, without changing or dropping any other source content. Root read the four row sentence templates and independently reviewed their source-local meaning, then compared every instantiated statement and row metadata (3638 atoms in 544 occurrences) against exact source values using a separately authored comparison. All 104 non-row atoms were reviewed as seven shared header templates applied to ten explicitly read tables plus all 34 individual prose/version/variable/link atoms. The mechanical exact-atom comparison supplements rather than replaces the independent full-body semantic read.
exact_atom_comparison_command:
python -c 'import json, gzip, hashlib, re
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
p = Path("evidence/source-reviews/docs-codeql-query-tables-claims.json")
d = json.loads(p.read_text())
sources = {s["path"]: s for s in d["sources"]}
texts = {r["path"]: r for r in map(json.loads, gzip.open(".cache/sources/github__docs.text.jsonl.gz", "rt")) if r["path"] in sources}
assert len(texts) == len(sources) == 13
assert len(d["claims"]) == len({c["claim_id"] for c in d["claims"]}) == 3742
assert all(c["accepted_policy"] is False for c in d["claims"])
assert all(hashlib.sha256(texts[k]["content"].encode()).hexdigest() == s["sha256"] and s["read_lines"] == [1,len(texts[k]["content"].splitlines())] for k,s in sources.items())
assert all(type(c["start_line"]) is int and type(c["end_line"]) is int and 1 <= c["start_line"] <= c["end_line"] <= len(texts[c["path"]]["content"].splitlines()) for c in d["claims"])
row_count = atoms = 0
expected_occurrences = set()
mismatches = []
for path, r in texts.items():
    for i, line in enumerate(r["content"].splitlines(), 1):
        if not line.startswith("| ["):
            continue
        cells = [s.strip() for s in line.split("|")[1:-1]]
        assert len(cells) == 5
        match = re.fullmatch(r"\[(.*)\]\((.*)\)", cells[0])
        assert match
        name, url = match.groups()
        slug = url.rstrip("/").split("/")[-1]
        occurrence = path+"#L"+str(i)
        expected_occurrences.add(occurrence)
        actual = [c for c in d["claims"] if c.get("query_occurrence") == occurrence]
        expected = [
            ("The row identified by "+slug+" has display label "+json.dumps(name)+".", None, None, None, None),
            ("That query row links to "+url+".", None, None, None, None)
        ]
        for cwe in [v.strip() for v in cells[1].split(",")]:
            expected.append(("The "+slug+" row associates related CWE identity "+cwe+"; the source'\''s digit spelling is preserved.", cwe, None, None, None))
        for column,cell in zip(("Default","Extended","Autofix"),cells[2:]):
            icon_match = re.fullmatch(r'\''{% octicon "(check|x)" aria-label="(Included|Not included)" %}'\'', cell)
            assert icon_match
            icon,label = icon_match.groups()
            assert (icon,label) in (("check","Included"),("x","Not included"))
            expected.append(("For "+slug+", the "+column+" column records "+label+".", None, column, label, icon))
        got = [(c["statement"],c.get("cwe_identity"),c.get("column"),c.get("cell_label"),c.get("cell_icon")) for c in actual]
        if Counter(expected) != Counter(got):
            mismatches.append({"occurrence":occurrence,"expected_only":list((Counter(expected)-Counter(got)).elements()),"actual_only":list((Counter(got)-Counter(expected)).elements())})
        assert all(c["path"] == path and c["start_line"] == c["end_line"] == i and c["query_help_identity"] == url and c["source_strength"] == "REFERENCE" for c in actual)
        row_count += 1
        atoms += len(actual)
assert {c["query_occurrence"] for c in d["claims"] if "query_occurrence" in c} == expected_occurrences
assert row_count == 544 and atoms == 3638
print(json.dumps({"claims_sha256":hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"row_occurrences_compared":row_count,"row_atoms_compared":atoms,"non_row_atoms_separately_read":len(d["claims"])-atoms,"exact_atom_mismatches":mismatches,"identity_bounds_non_adoption":True,"semantic_truth_automatically_certified":False,"global_omission_certified":False}))
assert not mismatches
'
outcome: No bounded source-local fidelity or omission finding in this draft. No repairs or author repair recheck required.
qualifications: Default, Extended and Autofix are separate source table columns, not automatic controls or a verified installed query pack.
Related CWE digits are references, not independently reviewed external CWE definitions or root-cause proof.
Repeated Actions display labels preserve distinct targets/occurrences; matching CWE or name does not prove cross-language query equivalence.
Latest-release table prose is pinned authoring context. Initial GHES appliance bundles may not include every listed query.
No linked query implementation/help page inherited review, runtime availability, actual execution, detection effectiveness or rights claim.
